alerts_single_shape.name: alerts_single_shape
alerts_single_shape.value: "alerts"."recurring_mode" is not null or ("alerts"."parent_id" is null and "alerts"."instance_number" = 1)

investment_theses_active_content_check.name: investment_theses_active_content_check
investment_theses_active_content_check.value: "investment_theses"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR (nullif(btrim("investment_theses"."summary"), '') is not null AND nullif(btrim("investment_theses"."why_i_own_it"), '') is not null)

thesis_reviews_reflection_check.name: thesis_reviews_reflection_check
thesis_reviews_reflection_check.value: nullif(btrim("thesis_reviews"."what_improved"), '') is not null OR nullif(btrim("thesis_reviews"."what_deteriorated"), '') is not null OR nullif(btrim("thesis_reviews"."what_changed"), '') is not null

trade_plans_zone_order_v1_check.name: trade_plans_zone_order_v1_check
trade_plans_zone_order_v1_check.value: "trade_plans"."entry_zone_low" is null or "trade_plans"."entry_zone_high" is null or "trade_plans"."entry_zone_low" <= "trade_plans"."entry_zone_high"
